newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - September 27.

text.p: The following stories were reported in Friday's Daily Variety:

NEW YORK - Time Warner and Turner Broadcasting System confirmed Thursday that Warner Bros. will take responsibility for TBS' film and TV libraries, animation, syndication, consumer products and homevideo activities.

NEW YORK - Ted Turner, soon to be vice chairman of a merged Time Warner-Turner Broadcasting Systems, took the media giant's recent public spat with News Corp to a personal level Thursday when he likened News Corp. chairman Rupert Murdoch to Adolf Hitler.
NEW YORK - Newspaper publisher-broadcaster AH Belo is to buy broadcaster Providence Journal Co for $1.5 billion.

HOLLYWOOD - ABC is restructuring its Children's Entertainment division and giving Disney-ABC Cable president Geraldine Laybourne,and Walt Disney Television and Animation president Dean Valentine very broad roles in the direction of the unit.
HOLLYWOOD - News Corp.'s Fox Television is launching a regional cable sports network in southern California.
